label: Indie bookshop network
rawIdea: A shared online inventory for independent bookshops, so a customer can search once and reserve a book at the nearest indie shop that has it in stock instead of ordering from Amazon.

label: Regional spice club
rawIdea: A monthly subscription that sends home cooks one unusual regional spice blend, with the story of where it comes from and three weeknight recipes that use it.

label: Construction site log
rawIdea: An app for small construction crews to snap daily site photos and voice notes, which get turned into a clean weekly progress report for the homeowner automatically.
